intro.en: Matrices are tables of numbers. In machine learning a whole dataset is a matrix (rows = examples, columns = features) and most computations - from linear regression to neural networks - are matrix operations.
intro.ru: Matrices numbers ke tables hain. Machine learning mein poora dataset ek matrix hota hai (rows = examples, columns = features) aur zyada tar hisaab - linear regression se neural networks tak - matrix operations hi hain.

definition.en: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers with m rows and n columns (an m x n matrix). Matrices can be added (same size), multiplied (inner sizes must match), transposed, and - if square and non-singular - inverted.
definition.ru: Matrix numbers ki m rows aur n columns wali mustateel (rectangular) tarteeb hai (m x n matrix). Matrices jama ho sakti hain (ek hi size), zarab ho sakti hain (andar wale sizes barabar hon), transpose ho sakti hain, aur agar square aur non-singular hon to un ka inverse nikal sakta hai.

explanation.en: To multiply A (m x n) by B (n x p), each entry of the result C (m x p) is the dot product of a row of A with a column of B: C[i][j] = sum over k of A[i][k] x B[k][j]. Matrix multiplication is not commutative: AB is usually different from BA. The transpose flips rows and columns. The determinant of a 2 x 2 matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] is ad - bc; if it is 0 the matrix has no inverse (it is singular). The inverse of a 2 x 2 matrix is (1/det) [[d, -b], [-c, a]], and A times its inverse gives the identity matrix. In ML, the normal equation of linear regression w = (X^T X)^-1 X^T y uses exactly these operations.
explanation.ru: A (m x n) ko B (n x p) se zarab karne par natije C (m x p) ka har element A ki ek row aur B ke ek column ka dot product hota hai: C[i][j] = sum (k par) A[i][k] x B[k][j]. Matrix multiplication commutative nahi: AB aam taur par BA se mukhtalif hota hai. Transpose rows aur columns ko palat deta hai. 2 x 2 matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] ka determinant ad - bc hai; agar yeh 0 ho to inverse nahi hota (singular). 2 x 2 ka inverse (1/det) [[d, -b], [-c, a]] hai, aur A ko us ke inverse se zarab karne par identity matrix aati hai. ML mein linear regression ki normal equation w = (X^T X)^-1 X^T y bilkul yahi operations istemal karti hai.

subject: Mathematics

intro.en: Probability is the language of uncertainty, and many ML models (Naive Bayes, logistic regression) output probabilities. Bayes' theorem tells us how to update a belief when we see new evidence.
intro.ru: Probability ghair yaqeeni ki zubaan hai, aur kai ML models (Naive Bayes, logistic regression) probabilities dete hain. Bayes' theorem batata hai ke naya saboot milne par apna andaza kaise badlein.

definition.en: The conditional probability P(A | B) is the probability of A given that B happened: P(A and B) / P(B). Bayes' theorem reverses the condition: P(A | B) = P(B | A) P(A) / P(B).
definition.ru: Conditional probability P(A | B) yeh hai ke B ho chuka ho to A ka imkan: P(A aur B) / P(B). Bayes' theorem condition ko palat deta hai: P(A | B) = P(B | A) P(A) / P(B).

explanation.en: Probabilities lie between 0 and 1 and the probabilities of all outcomes add up to 1. For independent events P(A and B) = P(A) P(B). The total probability rule computes P(B) by summing over cases: P(B) = P(B | A) P(A) + P(B | not A) P(not A). In Bayes' theorem P(A) is the prior, P(B | A) the likelihood and P(A | B) the posterior. A famous lesson: even an accurate medical test gives many false alarms for a rare disease, because the prior is small. The binomial formula gives the probability of exactly k successes in n independent trials: C(n, k) p^k (1-p)^(n-k).
explanation.ru: Probabilities 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hoti hain aur tamam mumkin natijon ki probabilities ka sum 1 hota hai. Azad (independent) events ke liye P(A aur B) = P(A) P(B). Total probability ka qaida P(B) ko sab soorton ka sum kar ke nikalta hai: P(B) = P(B | A) P(A) + P(B | A nahi) P(A nahi). Bayes' theorem mein P(A) prior, P(B | A) likelihood aur P(A | B) posterior hai. Mashhoor sabaq: kisi nayab bimari ke liye durust test bhi bohat se ghalat alarm deta hai, kyunki prior chhota hota hai. Binomial formula n azad koshishon mein bilkul k kamyabiyon ki probability deta hai: C(n, k) p^k (1-p)^(n-k).

example.en: A disease affects 1% of people. A test detects it 99% of the time (P(+ | D) = 0.99) and gives a false positive 5% of the time (P(+ | not D) = 0.05). P(+) = 0.99 x 0.01 + 0.05 x 0.99 = 0.0099 + 0.0495 = 0.0594. P(D | +) = 0.0099 / 0.0594 = 0.167. So a positive result means only about a 16.7% chance of having the disease.
example.ru: Ek bimari 1% logon ko hoti hai. Test 99% dafa pakar leta hai (P(+ | D) = 0.99) aur 5% dafa ghalat positive deta hai (P(+ | D nahi) = 0.05). P(+) = 0.99 x 0.01 + 0.05 x 0.99 = 0.0594. P(D | +) = 0.0099 / 0.0594 = 0.167. Yaani positive result ka matlab sirf takreeban 16.7% imkan hai ke bimari ho.

subject: Mathematics

intro.en: Derivatives measure how fast a function changes. Training an ML model means finding the parameters where the loss is lowest, and derivatives (gradients) show the way.
intro.ru: Derivatives batate hain ke function kitni tezi se badalta hai. ML model ki training ka matlab woh parameters dhoondna hai jahan loss sab se kam ho, aur derivatives (gradients) rasta dikhate hain.

definition.en: The derivative f'(x) is the instantaneous rate of change (the slope of the tangent line) of f at x. At a minimum or maximum of a smooth function the derivative is 0.
definition.ru: Derivative f'(x) x par f ki fori tabdeeli ki raftaar (tangent line ka slope) hai. Hamwar function ke minimum ya maximum par derivative 0 hota hai.

explanation.en: Basic rules: the power rule d/dx x^n = n x^(n-1); the derivative of a constant is 0; derivatives of sums are sums of derivatives; the chain rule d/dx f(g(x)) = f'(g(x)) g'(x); and d/dx e^x = e^x, d/dx ln x = 1/x. To find a minimum, solve f'(x) = 0 and check the second derivative: f''(x) > 0 means a minimum, f''(x) < 0 a maximum. A function of several variables has a partial derivative for each variable; together they form the gradient vector, which gradient descent follows downhill. Integration is the reverse of differentiation and gives the area under a curve.
explanation.ru: Buniyadi qaide: power rule d/dx x^n = n x^(n-1); constant ka derivative 0; sum ka derivative derivatives ka sum; chain rule d/dx f(g(x)) = f'(g(x)) g'(x); aur d/dx e^x = e^x, d/dx ln x = 1/x. Minimum dhoondne ke liye f'(x) = 0 hal karein aur second derivative dekhein: f''(x) > 0 matlab minimum, f''(x) < 0 maximum. Kai variables wale function ka har variable ke liye partial derivative hota hai; mil kar yeh gradient vector banate hain, jis ke ulat gradient descent neeche jata hai. Integration differentiation ka ulat hai aur curve ke neeche ka area deta hai.

example.en: f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 10. f'(x) = 2x - 6. Setting 2x - 6 = 0 gives x = 3. f''(x) = 2 > 0, so x = 3 is a minimum, with f(3) = 9 - 18 + 10 = 1.

key_concepts.en: Derivative of a composition: outer derivative times inner derivative (the basis of backpropagation).

key_concepts.en: Where f'(x) = 0; candidate minimum or maximum.
key_concepts.ru: Jahan f'(x) = 0; mumkin minimum ya maximum.

intro.en: Descriptive statistics summarise data with a few numbers. They appear everywhere in ML: feature scaling uses the mean and standard deviation, and Gaussian Naive Bayes models each feature with them.
intro.ru: Descriptive statistics data ko chand numbers mein samet leti hain. Yeh ML mein har jagah hain: feature scaling mean aur standard deviation istemal karti hai, aur Gaussian Naive Bayes har feature ko inhi se model karta hai.

definition.en: The mean is the average value; the variance is the average squared distance from the mean; the standard deviation is the square root of the variance and is measured in the same units as the data.
definition.ru: Mean average value hai; variance mean se squared faaslon ka average hai; standard deviation variance ka square root hai aur data ki units mein hi hota hai.

explanation.en: The population variance divides by n; the sample variance divides by n - 1 (Bessel's correction) because the sample mean is itself estimated from the data. The median is the middle value and is robust to outliers, unlike the mean. A z-score (x - mean) / std tells how many standard deviations a value is from the mean; standardising every feature this way gives mean 0 and standard deviation 1, which is what feature scaling for KNN, SVM and gradient descent does. For a normal distribution about 68% of values lie within 1 standard deviation of the mean and about 95% within 2.
explanation.ru: Population variance n se taqseem karti hai; sample variance n - 1 se (Bessel ki correction), kyunki sample mean khud data se andaza lagaya gaya hai. Median beech wali value hai aur mean ke baraks outliers se kam mutasir hoti hai. z-score (x - mean) / std batata hai ke value mean se kitne standard deviations door hai; har feature ko is tarah standardise karne se mean 0 aur standard deviation 1 ho jata hai, KNN, SVM aur gradient descent ke liye feature scaling yahi karti hai. Normal distribution mein takreeban 68% values mean se 1 standard deviation ke andar aur takreeban 95% 2 ke andar hoti hain.

example.en: Data: 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9. Mean = 40 / 8 = 5. Squared deviations: 9, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 4, 16, sum = 32. Population variance = 32 / 8 = 4, standard deviation = 2. Sample variance = 32 / 7 = 4.571, sample standard deviation = 2.138. The z-score of 9 is (9 - 5) / 2 = 2.
example.ru: Data: 2, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 7, 9. Mean = 40 / 8 = 5. Squared farq: 9, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 4, 16, sum = 32. Population variance = 32 / 8 = 4, standard deviation = 2. Sample variance = 32 / 7 = 4.571, sample standard deviation = 2.138. 9 ka z-score (9 - 5) / 2 = 2.
